name: Should I choose a double vanity or keep a single vanity with more open floor space?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a double vanity or keep a single vanity with more open floor space?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best layout is the one that supports how people actually use the room while leaving comfortable paths around the door, toilet, vanity, and shower. A double vanity may help a shared primary bathroom but consume storage or circulation space; a single vanity may create better counter space or a wider passage. Door swing, privacy, towel placement, mirror lighting, shower entry, and cleaning access matter as much as appearance. Mark the proposed fixtures on a scaled plan and test the door and shower entries before approving it. Elite Remodeling & Design can use 3D design visualization to help compare alternatives before construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a double vanity when two people regularly use the room and the remaining circulation stays comfortable. Keep a single vanity when floor space, storage, counter width, or a wider shower matters more. Test both options on a scaled plan, including door swing, toilet clearance, lighting, outlets, and cabinet storage.
